front: What does section 75 of the Constitution protect?
back: The right to basic state-funded education.

Which helpline can a child call in Zimbabwe?
Name four ways beliefs and practices can harm education.
back: Refusal of schooling, child marriage and pledging, gender bias, and clashes of views or activities with school.

front: Why should we not blame a whole religion for these problems?
back: They come from particular practices; most members and leaders of the same religion support education.

front: Suggest three ways of addressing negative impacts on education.
back: Dialogue and awareness, enforcing the law, and bursaries; also religious leaders' support and flexible school arrangements.
